summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Tailscale 的安全远程访问运营面板：一键健康检查、HTTPS 入口开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维、ACL 生成。Tailscale remote-access control panel for DeepSeek Harness: health checks, HTTPS serve toggle, proxy bypass, relay ops, ACL helper.
